player_prompt.intro:
Wee ndi Player {player_id} mu Chopsticks. Pa turn yako, chagua moja ya:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=hand yako (0 or 1), O=hand ya mkweli (0 or 1).
    - Hand ya mkweli ikwama kwa hand yako; ikawa >=5, ikhoza ku 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  kutengeneza tenge hand yako yote ku L na R (L+R = hand yako yote).
Lonta na moja ya njira zikho.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Dzanja la mdani {opp_idx} ndi lakufa kale.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Gawo liyenera kusintha kugawa kwanu kwa dzanja.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kupezeka kwa njira. Tumia “[attack M O]” or “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} akutentha P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: ikhoza ku {opp_val} mpaka {new_val}.
